title: What the Fist Held

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The fist that opens toward the road has not given and the road has not taken. The corner keeps its grey a hair thinner where nobody swept. What the weather does, no household owns, and a day goes uncounted all the same.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Low Kiln yard, told over the well in Silt

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and forty-one to four hundred and forty-three days, six months and two hundred and sixty-one to two hundred and sixty-three days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 440 exact at the opening on answer 456, closing at 443 exact on answer 462. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the Drawing a room seen and not entered, the out-of-line landing a report brought up the yard and never a sighting. Silt 17, 18 and 19 are three ordinary tending days, each with its own dated \daymark and two full scenes of at least eight hundred words, with no market, no Cross, no bell, no Account-day, no called collector and no runner. Nothing from Tarn's withheld sentence of Silt 15 or the hair-thin thaw and softer river air of Silt 16 crosses under the roof on any of the three days as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and neither is told again on an unearned day. The house takes up its grammar as though nothing had turned. Sella keeps the whole hearth grammar at both ends of every day, the grain covered and unfigured, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, the widow's mark untouched, the charcoal unread beneath her finger and the fold righted without a second fold; seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule. On Silt 18 a man waiting his turn at the yard well opens a shut fist not toward the water but toward the clay road, looks at the light and shuts the fist again, the number arriving nowhere; the boy files the direction on a place of its own beside the fist-to-nowhere arrivals and the offered figure and its return, with a finger between every pair — not a second offer, not a custom, not a payment, not a reader, not a sale, not a sixth shaping and not joined to the well-asking, the clerk's entered figure or the neighbour's near-reaching (T077 with T061/T082 advanced, not paid). On Silt 19 the clean dark line at the Vail corner keeps its finer grey called the thaw a hair less distinct along a second stretch where no broom has gone, and the air off the river is softer at one edge where the low note runs nearer under its skin; the boy finds both where put, calls them weather, does not look twice and makes no fourth covering, sign, payment or fourth likeness (T083/T085/T092 with T009/T013/T092 advanced, not paid). Four readings of the year stand behind one unsigned figure up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box, four being four and not one account, with Silt 20 (Day 444), the month's second reading and the year's fifth, standing one morning beyond the close as a date and not brought.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Seventeenth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first dated \daymark{441}{Silt 17, Y.H. 814, Seventhday}: the small hours open on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 456 and the count exact at 440, six months and two hundred and sixty days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, four readings of the year behind one unsigned figure up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box behind the twelve of Y.H. 813, four being four and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space. Tarn's sentence told the wood on Silt 14, withheld on Silt 15 and said again on Silt 16, the hair-thin thaw of Silt 16 and the softer river air stand each on its own place with a finger between and are not told again on a morning that earned only its seventeenth; do not recap them, do not make a lesson of the fourth reading. Then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning work of an ordinary Seventhday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects only (salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with its finer grey called the thaw, twice-mended pot with the hairline showing, unforged collector sentence beside the seventh notch, uncalled tile debt). Ilva offstage with her count still in wood and her fear unpaid; Hessa's slate unread up the road, Berr up the clay road with the box locked and the key gone up in a coat pocket, the soft-cuffed clerk reported at the out-of-line landing and never a sighting. No market, Cross, bell, reading, runner or collector. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — one stiff brown-edged barley crust gone past leather into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the keeping at the fold found where put in the empty place and still a finding and not a placing, the thread stiff in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back as at the end of a written line, a face composed by cold not being composure and a cold patient not being able to clot, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and knows a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for. The infant's three wants — crust lifted two inches, thread wiped, a hand on the pot handle — quarrel with the surgeon's register; both true, the second louder, neither buying the other, the quarrel the work and no verdict (T060/T086/T097). Sella's whole grammar holds ahead of the basket: fire before basket, coals told it is the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, the small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger along the shelf's top so the charcoal stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand shut half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool unfigured, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a Seventhday morning is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, the knife at the sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, the sentence found where put and not made a habit, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word in an ended term with the loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006); Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it from any High Kiln master, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of an unfinished sentence with one bite holding and one taking and no Grathic word for both, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn against the burned slate at five (T035/T031/T062). The boy keeps 441 exact, six months and 261 days, and files answer 457 on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a doctrine (T071/T072).

scenes.title: What the Seventeenth Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Silt 17 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 458 filed and the count at 441 exact, six months and two hundred and sixty-one days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Tarn and Jorra Vail offstage at kindling and wheel-shed with their keepings found where put; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only at the yard grammar: a pail set down on the flat stone by the well with its flat knock, a rope settling into its knot with the cold-stiffened rasp, barley wall to wall without a number, a loaf pushed a finger's width along a board and stopped with nobody calling the stopping a figure. Ilva offstage with her strip in wood and her ninth hand nine; Hessa's single slate unread up the road, Berr's box locked up the road, the clerk reported at the landing never a sighting. Tarn's withheld word of Silt 15 and the two greys of Silt 16 are not repeated on a day that earned only its seventeenth. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather, and takes each apart by fist, eye, mouth and the half-beat in the gap, giving the gap no intention, for an intention wants a payer where none stands (T061/T082). He goes once around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest at the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back — no name, no body, no figure, no accident, no payer; the trough keeps the gone pan's round print on a place of its own, and the two unswept lines at the Vail corner keep a finger between the clean dark line and its finer grey called the thaw, thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash, unswept and called weather, not looked at twice (T098, T009/T013/T092, T083/T085/T092 held). Costs come as directions and go away as weather: a fist up out of a shut hand toward the water or the light, looked at, shut, back into a sleeve, arriving nowhere; a woman sent to ask a pot's cost gets a note and not a price; the arithmetic read over covered grain at home does not know what it cost and the ink-neat space between figure and price carries no signature (T077). No slate opened within reach of the basket, no figure entered, no money passed. Sella carries him home at the going of the light at the half-pace and says nothing to the basket of what the day was; the whole grammar returns at both ends of the day, the fold righted without a look at his face and no second fold, the keeping found where put (T058/T079/T100, T060/T086/T097). In the small hours the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done; he goes over the day by the place of each thing with every gap a gap and does not add them. Six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing house's flat knock outside on its own place; heard bell beside told with both gaps in their squares and three counts in three places staying three; nine record-first hands with nine stoppings and no tenth; seven openings in seven months not a rule. The withheld sentence of Silt 15, the thaw and softer air of Silt 16, the offered figure and its return, the second asking of Silt 12, the Slate Row face of Silt 13, the reported second slate of Silt 6, the neighbour's near-reaching, the hair-thin thaw of Silt 7, the clerk's entered figure brought up the yard as a report and never a sighting, the fifth shaping of the well-saying, the three likenesses of Slate Row, the burned slate at five and the four ownerless directions stand each on its own place with a finger between every pair — none a reader, a witness, a tenth hand, a custom, a payment or a payer, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T061/T082, T078, T080/T090/T102, T097, T065/T095, T101 held). Four readings of the year stand behind one unsigned figure and none is made to answer any kept thing under this roof; the unsent call to Nina stands where it was put and is not paid again (T015/T041/T047, T020). Answer 458 filed; count holds at 441 exact; the fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number; Silt 20 (Day 444) stands three mornings off as a date and is not brought. Through the finger's-width door the river keeps its low note of water over water; the hand comes up an inch toward it (the inch not a reach), takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's finishing, lets it go and comes straight down flat on the fold on answer 458; there is no next hand in the room, he does not wipe the thread and does not lift the crust.

scenes.title: The Eighteenth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{442}{Silt 18, Y.H. 814, Eighthday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 458 and the count exact at 441, six months and two hundred and sixty-one days told by nobody; then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning of an ordinary Eighthday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar; Ilva offstage with her strip still in her sleeve and her fear unpaid. No market, Cross, bell, Account-day, called collector or runner, and nothing from Silt 17 crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. New day, new date, no recap. Dramatic purpose: the body is inventoried in the old order and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086/T097); the surgeon reads the house by what it will not say rather than by what it will not survive, and a warm room insisting a body is warm while the fingers go the colour of old rope is read past tense and untagged, paying nothing (T004 held). The morning's honest work is given its texture — dressed grain lifted for damp, turned piece by piece with a progressively lighter touch and laid back under wool with no figure or handful, the pot board and twice-mended pot with the hairline showing, the half-beat at the setting — and Sella's fire-before-basket grammar holds ahead of the basket in every order; the widow's mark is untouched because an Eighthday morning is not an opening and seven openings are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). Tarn's six stand in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip, the knife at the sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, the sentence found where put and not made a habit, a tenth stopping, a payment or a rule; ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan in an ended term, loan uncalled, Ash in the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring at the left wrist, *Yes, house* (T036/T076/T006). Jorra's meal-fine grey slate dust is ground small past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, three or more unnamed men gone low into the back room before first grey and given no name, wheel and pot spoken to before any person, bent finger into the cold damper ahead of the unfinished sentence with one holding and one taking and no second holding of Ash 26, *he's not Vail* sealed, promise ungiven against the burned slate at five (T035/T031/T062). The boy keeps 442 exact, six months and 262 days, and files answer 459 on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air and not a doctrine (T071/T072). The morning gives no sign of the afternoon's direction at the well.

scenes.title: What the Eighteenth Left
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Silt 18 afternoon at the yard well, going of the light, small hours at the close, with answer 460 filed and the count at 442 exact, six months and two hundred and sixty-two days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan (carried to the well), Sella Vail; Tarn and Jorra Vail offstage at kindling and wheel-shed with their keepings found where put; Garl Vail in objects. Day already dated in Scene 3. Dramatic purpose: **the chapter's first advance, advanced and NOT paid (T077 with T061/T082).** A man waiting his turn at the yard well opens a shut fist not toward the water but toward the clay road, looks at the light and shuts the fist again, the number arriving nowhere; no slate is opened within reach of the basket, no figure is given, no money passes, he gives no name, no room is entered and he stands in no relation to the boy. The boy takes the direction apart by the place of each part — fist toward the road, eye to the light, fist shut and back into a sleeve, the half-beat in the gap with no intention in it, for an intention wants a payer where none stands — and files the direction on a place of its own beside the fist-to-nowhere arrivals and Ilva's offered figure and its return, with a finger between every pair: expressly **not a second offer, not a custom, not a payment, not a reader, not a sale, not a sixth shaping**, not the calling of the loan, and not joined to the well-asking answered with weather, the clerk's entered figure brought up the yard as a report from the out-of-line landing, the neighbour's near-reaching at the loaf shelf, the reported second slate of Silt 6 or the two market sightings. Ilva, drawing with the pail against her knee, is offstage-with-her-keeping in this chapter: her hand stays in her sleeve, the notched birch strip is not taken out, read, copied, counted or shown, no figure comes off the wood, and she is expressly not the speaker of any word at this well and is not made a reader by the direction's nearness. The direction gathers interest toward the far-off hand that will one day lay the district's private keepings together and call them an account, and that hand is not his and has not come. Sella carries him home at the going of the light and says nothing to the basket of the direction; the grammar returns as though nothing had turned, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the widow's mark untouched, the fold righted without a second fold, the keeping found where put (T058/T079/T100, T060/T086/T097). Costs go away as weather; the six hearings stay six with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside; the withheld sentence of Silt 15 and the greys of Silt 16 stay on their own trays and are not repeated on a day that earned only its eighteenth (T061/T082, T083/T085/T092 held). Answer 460 filed; count holds at 442 exact; the fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number. Silt 20 (Day 444) stands two mornings off and is not brought.

scenes.title: The Nineteenth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{443}{Silt 19, Y.H. 814, Ninthday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 460 and the count exact at 442, six months and two hundred and sixty-two days told by nobody; then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning of an ordinary Ninthday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar; Ilva offstage with her count still in wood and her fear unpaid. No market, Cross, bell, Account-day, called collector or runner, and nothing from the well-direction of Silt 18 crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; it is **not** repeated on a day that earned only its nineteenth. New day, new date, no recap. Dramatic purpose: the body is inventoried in the old order — horn-hard crust with its hair-lifted corner two inches off, keeping found where put in the empty place, thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint, Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform — and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086/T097); the surgeon's register reads the body by the order of its small failures and buys nothing. Sella's grammar holds at the morning: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, charcoal unread under her finger, twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing, dressed grain covered under wool and unfigured, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a Ninthday morning is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). Tarn's six stand in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip, the small knife at the sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, the sentence found where put and not made a habit, a tenth stopping, a payment, a hearing or a rule; the ear-sentence stays stopped at the word that would call the loan in an ended term, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, his valuable ear exposure and not safety (T036/T076/T006). Jorra's dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, unnamed men low in the back room before first grey, wheel and pot spoken to before any person, bent finger leading at the cold damper with one bite holding and one taking and no second holding of Ash 26, full note known three turns ahead and withheld from any High Kiln master, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn while the burned slate stands at five; the two quiet men stay unjoined (T035/T031/T062). The boy keeps 443 exact, six months and 263 days, and files answer 461 on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air and not a doctrine (T071/T072). The morning gives no sign of the afternoon's second stretch of grey.

scenes.title: What the Nineteenth Left
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Silt 19 afternoon at the Vail corner and the finger's-width door, going of the light, small hours closing the chapter, with answer 462 filed and the count at 443 exact, six months and two hundred and sixty-three days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Tarn and Jorra Vail offstage at kindling and wheel-shed with their keepings found where put; Garl Vail in objects; Ilva offstage with her count in wood and her fear unpaid. Day already dated in Scene 5. Dramatic purpose: **the chapter's second advance, advanced and NOT paid (T083/T085/T092 with T009/T013/T092).** In the afternoon, at the Vail corner, the clean dark line keeps its finer grey called the thaw a hair less distinct along a **second** stretch where no broom has gone, thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash; through the finger's-width door the air off the river is softer at one edge where the low note of water over water runs nearer under the winter skin, the tang thinner there. He finds both where put, does not look twice, calls them weather — not a sign, not a fourth covering, not a fourth likeness, not a sixth shaping, not a payment, with no hand or payer under either grey and not made again. Sella tells the fire it is the thaw and does not tell the basket. The two greys at the corner keep a finger between the called-gone beside the left-in-place; a thing left in place is not a thing forgiven. The old-life register supplies the shape of frost leaving a ward window in two lines that met at a corner and a nurse calling it the weather and going on with her count, read by where the lines stopped and not by the name given them — past tense, untagged, paying nothing, with no present-tense break spent and no \memory{} tag used (T004 held). Sella carries him home at the going of the light at the half-pace, says nothing to the basket of the greys or of what the day was; the whole grammar comes back as though nothing had turned, widow's mark untouched, fold righted without a look at his face and no second fold, keeping found where put (T058/T079, T060/T086/T097). Small hours: the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done, rough from the wash and smelling of tallow and low smoke. He goes over the day by the place of each thing with every gap a gap and does not add them. Six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's knock outside; heard bell beside told with both gaps in squares and three counts in three places staying three; nine record-first hands with nine stoppings and no tenth; seven openings in seven months and not a rule. The well-direction of Silt 18 stands on its own place beside the fist-to-nowhere arrivals and the offered figure and its return; Tarn's withheld sentence of Silt 15, the hair-thin thaw of Silt 16, the second asking of Silt 12, the Slate Row face of Silt 13, the reported second slate of Silt 6, the neighbour's near-reaching, the clerk's entered figure, the fifth shaping, the three likenesses and the two market sightings on separate trays stand each on its own place with a finger between every pair (T077, T061/T082/T078, T080/T090/T102, T050/T051). Four readings of the year stand behind one unsigned figure — four being four and not one account, the first not a thirteenth, the second no signature, the third no doctrine, the fourth no payer, the twelve of Y.H. 813 not laid across the four, the figure read still not the figure paid — and none is made to answer any kept thing under this roof; Silt 20 (Day 444), the month's second reading and the year's fifth, stands one morning off as a date and is not brought (T015/T041/T047). The unsent call to Nina stays where it was put and is not paid again (T020). Answer 462 filed on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment; six honest answers 457–462 stand there, two to each of the three days, not one a doctrine, and 462 answers stand there in all. Count 443 exact, six months and 263 days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the man and the fire standing side by side without becoming one, for a number counted is a number with air around it and air buys no warmth (T088). Through the finger's-width door the river keeps its low note of water over water under the winter skin, softer at one edge, the note coming from under the covering and ending on its own finishing. The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward it — the inch not a reach, not a wanting made into a claim, only the body's small assent to a sound — takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's finishing, lets it go and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. There is no next hand in the room. He does not wipe the thread and does not lift the crust. Under the boards the four low pulls keep their silence where the fifth should have stood and nobody supplies the pull.
